name: ring/arena presentation
largest_gap: flat-void fraction 0.618 -> 0.110, but read that carefully: most of the later drop came from the camera slice's 41-degree lens cropping the hall out of frame, not from more arena being built. The shell is still grey-box -- raked boxes with a noise albedo, no entrance stage, no ring skirt, no crowd motion -- and lighting consistency (bar priority 2) remains UNJUDGED: every capture is llvmpipe and evidence_gate.py --visual voids them for this slice.

name: wrestler look & materials
largest_gap: silhouette separation from the mat went 0.014 -> 0.172 dL, still short of the reference's 0.24-0.31, and the two wrestlers now separate by hue as the reference does. What is left is the model itself: one CC0 mannequin at two tints, no distinct body types, no faces, no attire geometry, one material per man. Material believability (bar priority 3) is UNJUDGED pending a GPU capture.

name: HUD/UI
largest_gap: the vitality bar was reading against a 400-damage scale while the match is played on a 200 one, so a wrestler one hit from losing showed 54-75% health; fixed, and each plate now carries its wrestler's own attire accent. Still missing against hud.md: portraits, the fill-animation behaviour hud.md marks pending (easing, flash-on-threshold, damage-tick delay), and legibility across a lighting range the game does not yet have.

name: grapple chain & paired-move quality
largest_gap: phase 4 not yet started, but the camera slice's live-match probe found something this slice owns: across five seeds peak momentum was 50-59 against SIGNATURE_THRESHOLD 60 and FINISHER_THRESHOLD 100, so the top two rungs of the move ladder never fired. A signature costs exactly 60 and is checked just below the finisher, so a wrestler who reaches 60 spends it at his next grapple and the remaining 40 needs ~7 strikes landed with no grapple between. Left as-is rather than rebalanced from inside a camera slice.

name: camera framing
largest_gap: the follow-cam is solved from measurement now -- subject fill 0.29 -> inside the reference's own bands, and the dead cut modes (which froze the camera permanently if ever called) are driven off the match's events. What is not measured: FOV is DERIVED (41 deg, from fill plus 'just outside the near ropes'), the fit's separations are derived from that same FOV rather than observed, and ease curves plus cut duration stay pending real footage per camera.md. The containment guard's width limit is an engineering value, not a reference number.
